_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Harvest at the Ruebenfeld, the peasant-onboarding chore gate (GDD 5). ⚑ QUESTS (plan-quests.md C4): the Farmer offers and turns in `turnip-chore`, the harvest-verb quest — its target species is only damageable by the `harvest`-tagged aura he teaches at root in the same conversation, which is why the offer row navigates there. Quest nodes above root, back-to-root rows on each: see docs/manual-content-authoring.md § Quests.
name: Farmer

lines: North row's ready and I'm not. Boars will have the lot of it by the week's end.

grants.line: Five will do. And don't go pulling them up by hand — ask me how it's done first, I'll not have you bruising the crop.

lines: Five out of the north row, and mind the treeline while you're bent over.
That's the row cleared, then. Let's see them.

options.text: Your turnips are out of the ground.

grants.line: ...Aye. All five. The row would have rotted without you, and I'll not pretend otherwise.
Honest work. It counts for something, whatever the crier says.

lines: Tend to the field if you have time... or go out there adventuring. I know what I would pick.

grants.line: If Adventuring becomes too stressful, there is always farming!
